name: SPCAM Control (0K) and Warmed (+4K) simulations
size_as_stated: 3.4 Terabytes of data over 90 days, with 76,944,384 samples
resolution: Host GCM: 1.9° x 2.5°; Embedded CRM: 512 km extent, 128 columns, 4 km horizontal resolution, 30 vertical levels; 4-hour snapshot frequency
access: The codebase for running the “SPCAM5” simulations is the same employed by [31], which is archived at https://github.com/mspritch/UltraCAM-spcam2_0_cesm1_1_1; this code was in turn forked from a development version of the CESM1.1.1 located on the NCAR central subversion repository under tag spcam_cam5_2_00_forCESM1_1_1Rel_V09, which dates to February 25, 2013.

scales.note: SPCAM embedded 4 km CRM in 1.9x2.5 degree GCM, 4-hour snapshots over 90-day runs totaling 3.4 TB
